sources.title: Sentiment Classification Using BERT - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: In this post, we will be using BERT architecture for Sentiment classification tasks specifically the architecture used for the CoLA (Corpus of Linguistic Acceptability) binary classification task.

sources.title: Most Popular Machine Learning Models for Sentiment Analysis
sources.snippet: By exploring the most popular machine learning models for sentiment analysis, developers and data scientists can make informed decisions based on their unique goals, datasets, and resources.

sources.title: AI Sentiment Analyzer - GitHub
sources.snippet: A simple AI-powered sentiment analysis application built with Hugging Face Transformers and Gradio. The application takes a piece of text as input and predicts whether the sentiment is Positive or Negative, along with the model's confidence scores.
